considered: trojan-horse: a two-page typed memo hides the whole machinery of a nation's mourning (calls, statement, the cut-off, a burial at sea)
historical-echo: newsrooms pre-write obituaries today; the White House pre-wrote two in 1969
live-viewer-trap: show the speech first and let the viewer believe it was read, then reveal it never was
owner_words: "give me sample of 60 seconds on any topic of your choice. freehand. make sure you show me what you have learnt. first give me visuals before creating videos" (2026-11-14): the owner delegated the topic and the pick
why: trojan-horse lets the real document lead (gate 3) and turns a short memo into the reveal of a hidden plan; historical-echo needs a modern comparison we have not sourced; live-viewer-trap risks presenting a speech as if it was given
